thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Sees Large Increase in Short Interest

author: Max Byerly
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Sees Large Increase in Short Interest
text:
Tweet 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) saw a large growth in short interest in the month of February. As of February 15th, there was short interest totalling 49,152,571 shares, a growth of 16.8% from the January 31st total of 42,078,757 shares. Currently, 1.0% of the shares of the stock are short sold. Based on an average daily volume of 58,301,658 shares, the days-to-cover ratio is currently 0.8 days. 
Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $175.00 on Friday. The company has a market capitalization of $887,950.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.12, a PEG ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. Apple has a 1 year low of $137.05 and a 1 year high of $180.62. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current year. The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.44%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. Apple’s payout ratio is 24.66%. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, December 7th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total transaction of $2,654,121.29. Following the sale, the insider now owns 17,341 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $2,942,594.29. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. 
Several institutional investors and hedge funds have recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at about $108,000. University of Texas Investment Managment Co. purchased a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter valued at about $114,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC grew its stake in Apple by 852.4% during the 2nd quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the last quarter. Private Vista LLC purchased a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at about $122,000. Finally, Armbruster Capital Management Inc. grew its stake in Apple by 9.4% during the 2nd quarter. Armbruster Capital Management Inc. now owns 911 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $131,000 after purchasing an additional 78 shares during the last quarter. 59.70% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. 
Several analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 13th. Bank of America downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and lifted their target price for the company from $180.00 to $220.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 17th. Cascend Securities lifted their target price on Apple from $200.00 to $220.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, January 29th. Nomura set a $185.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, November 27th. Finally, UBS Group reissued a “buy” rating and set a $190.00 target price (up previously from $180.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, November 3rd. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.58. 
About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
